package.name: so101_description
package.description: URDF/xacro description and RViz config for the SO-101 6-DOF arm. Phase 1 of the ROS2 Jazzy migration of robot_sam2_app_v2. Ships a minimal placeholder URDF that renders in RViz with no external assets; the official SO-ARM101 URDF/meshes can be dropped in later (see urdf/FETCH_OFFICIAL_URDF.md).
